correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the stack-sort orbit of 23...n1 as the identity plus orthogonal d_k vectors, with d_k·d_k=k(k−1), d_j·d_k=0 for distinct indices. Dual normals give precisely (n−1 choose 2) right and n−1 exceptional acute dihedral angles arccos sqrt(n/[(n−1)k(k−1)]); each unordered ridge is one facet pair. Conditional K uniform on 2..n gives nδ_{n,K} ⇒1/U with Pareto(1) tail. Uniform harmonic comparison gives A_n=log n+O(1), dominated square series gives B_n→C₂>0, yielding conditional first and second moments and the unconditional mean/variance coefficient, with all n≥3 and distinct-angle boundaries. Independent fresh orbit/Gram code reconstructed exact orbits and dot products for n=3..18, 168 orbit vertices; finite checks do not prove asymptotics.
